posts.text: 查看干部任免审批表(V4) 1.配置取数 [干部管理] - [干审表取数逻辑] 2.云函数 - 动态OpenAPI PersonnelReviewFormResume  PersonnelReviewFormResume(BasePrivateApiService): """ 动态私有OpenAPI 使用方法 """ def get_empeducation_datas(self, now_str, empid): """ 获取教育信息 """ param = { "model": "EmployeeEducation", "filter_dict": { "date_": now_str, "employee_id": empid }, "fields_key":["school", "specialty", "u_major_id"], "state": "inside" } return ModelUtil.list(**param) def get_outerexperience_datas(self, now_str, empid): """ 获取外部工作经历信息 """ param = { "model": "OuterExperience", "filter_dict": { "date_": now_str, "employee_id": empid }, "fields_key":["company_name", "department_name", "position_name"], "state": "inside" } return ModelUtil.list(**param) def get_jobinformationmaster_datas(self, now_str, empid): """ 获取现任职信息 """ param = { "model": "JobInformationMaster", "filter_dict": { "date_": now_str, "date": now_str, "on_job": "1", "employee_id": empid }, "fields_key":["unit.org_full_name", "department.name", "position.name"], "state": "inside" } return ModelUtil.list(**param) def parse_resume_text_to_list(self, resume_text): """ 将履历文本字符串解析成结构化的列表 Args: resume_text (str): 履历文本字符串 Returns: list: 结构化的履历列表，每个元素包含begin_date, end_date, resume """ result = [] # 按行分割 lines = resume_text.strip().split('\n') max_num = len(lines)-1 for idx,line in enumerate(lines): line = line.strip() if not line or line.startswith('(') or line.startswith('（'): continue # 匹配日期和内容 - 支持多种分隔符 match = re.match(r'(\d{4}\.\d{2})--(\d{4}\.\d{2}|\s)\s+(.+)', line) if match: start_date_str, end_date_str, resume_content = match.groups() # 转换日期格式 start_date = self.convert_to_full_date(start_date_str) end_date = self.convert_to_full_date(end_date_str) if end_date_str.strip() else '至 今' nidx = idx+1 if nidx <= max_num: next_line = lines[nidx] strip_next_line = next_line.strip() if strip_next_line.startswith('(') or strip_next_line.startswith('（'): resume_content += f"\n{next_line}" result.append({ 'begin_date': start_date, 'end_date': end_date, 'resume': resume_content }) return result @staticmethod def convert_to_full_date(date_str): """ 将YYYY-MM格式转换为YYYY-MM-DD格式 Args: date_str (str): 日期字符串 Returns: str: 完整日期字符串 """ try: # 如果是完整的日期，直接返回 if re.match(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', date_str): return date_str # 如果是YYYY-MM格式，补充为YYYY-MM-01 if re.match(r'\d{4}-\d{2}', date_str): year_month = date_str.split('-') if len(year_month) == 2: return f"{year_month[0]}-{year_month[1]}-01" return date_str except: return date_str def execute(self, **kwargs): try: now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") employee_id = kwargs.get("employee_id") resume_text = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("get.appointment.dismissal.new", {"employee_id": employee_id})[0].get('special_text_jobs_str') # self.record(f"resume_text0-{resume_text}") # 替换 学校+学科类别 ==> 学校+专业名称 emp_education_list = self.get_empeducation_datas(now_str, employee_id) # self.record(f"emp_education_list-{emp_education_list}") for empedu_obj in emp_education_list: sch_spec = f"{empedu_obj.get('school', '')}{empedu_obj.get('specialty', '')}" # self.record(f"sch_spec-{sch_spec}") sch_maj = f"{empedu_obj.get('school', '')}{empedu_obj.get('u_major_id', '')}" # self.record(f"sch_maj-{sch_maj}") resume_text = resume_text.replace(sch_spec, sch_maj) # self.record(f"resume_text1-{resume_text}") # 替换 过往工作经历，公司+部门(如果部门名称等于【企业领导或集团领导或无】) 不显示 outerexperience_list = self.get_outerexperience_datas(now_str, employee_id) # self.record(f"outerexperience_list-{outerexperience_list}") for outexp_obj in outerexperience_list: # 企业领导 old_business_leader = f"{outexp_obj.get('company_name', '')}企业领导{outexp_obj.get('position_name', '')}" new_business_leader = f"{outexp_obj.get('company_name', '')}{outexp_obj.get('position_name', '')}" resume_text = resume_text.replace(old_business_leader, new_business_leader) # 集团领导 old_group_leaders = f"{outexp_obj.get('company_name', '')}集团领导{outexp_obj.get('position_name', '')}" new_group_leaders = f"{outexp_obj.get('company_name', '')}{outexp_obj.get('position_name', '')}" resume_text = resume_text.replace(old_group_leaders, new_group_leaders) # 无 old_wu_leaders = f"{outexp_obj.get('company_name', '')}无{outexp_obj.get('position_name', '')}" new_wu_leaders = f"{outexp_obj.get('company_name', '')}{outexp_obj.get('position_name', '')}" resume_text = resume_text.replace(old_wu_leaders, new_wu_leaders) # self.record(f"resume_text2-{resume_text}") # 替换 现任职信息，公司+部门(如果部门名称等于【企业领导或集团领导或无】) 不显示 jobinformationmaster_list = self.get_jobinformationmaster_datas(now_str, employee_id) # self.record(f"jobinformationmaster_list-{jobinformationmaster_list}") for jobinfomaster_obj in jobinformationmaster_list: # 企业领导 old_business_masterleader = f"{jobinfomaster_obj.get('unit', {}).get('org_full_name', '')}企业领导{jobinfomaster_obj.get('position', {}).get('name', '')}" new_business_masterleader = f"{jobinfomaster_obj.get('unit', {}).get('org_full_name', '')}{jobinfomaster_obj.get('position', {}).get('name', '')}" resume_text = resume_text.replace(old_business_masterleader, new_business_masterleader) # 集团领导 old_group_masterleaders = f"{jobinfomaster_obj.get('unit', {}).get('org_full_name', '')}集团领导{jobinfomaster_obj.get('position', {}).get('name', '')}" new_group_masterleaders = f"{jobinfomaster_obj.get('unit', {}).get('org_full_name', '')}{jobinfomaster_obj.get('position', {}).get('name', '')}" resume_text = resume_text.replace(old_group_masterleaders, new_group_masterleaders) # 无 old_wu_masterleaders = f"{jobinfomaster_obj.get('unit', {}).get('org_full_name', '')}无{jobinfomaster_obj.get('position', {}).get('name', '')}" new_wu_masterleaders = f"{jobinfomaster_obj.get('unit', {}).get('org_full_name', '')}{jobinfomaster_obj.get('position', {}).get('name', '')}" resume_text = resume_text.replace(old_wu_masterleaders, new_wu_masterleaders) # self.record(f"resume_text3-{resume_text}") # return resume_text text_list = list() if resume_text: text_list = self.parse_resume_text_to_list(resume_text) # self.record(f"text_list-{text_list}") return text_list except Exception as e: self.record(f"错误:{traceback.format_exc()}") raise e def record(self, content, type_=3): """ 日志记录 :param content: 内容 :param type_: 2 异常 3 其他 :return: """ # employee_id=CustomerUtil.get_current_context().employee.id logging.info(content) company_id = CustomerUtil.get_current_context().company.id category = self.__class__.__name__ CustomerUtil.call_open_api( name="hcm.model.create", param={ "model": "SyncOuterRecord", "info": { "company_id": company_id, "name": category, "category": category, "type": type_, "content": {"content": "{}".format(content)}, "update_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") } } ) 返回数据格式 12345678910111213141516171819202122[ { "begin_date": "1900.07", "end_date": "1994.02", "resume": "纺织厂南整车间工人" }, { "begin_date": "1995.03", "end_date": "2006.02", "resume": "棉纺织有限公司团委宣传文体干事" }, { "begin_date": "2006.03", "end_date": "2010.01", "resume": "棉纺织有限公司团委副书记" }, { "begin_date": "2010.02", "end_date": "2022.01", "resume": "纺织有限公司团委副书记" }]

"dynamic.script.for.common.api.notify", "params": "=function(){return {'param': SCOPE.getAllFilterDict(),'plugin': 'generate_salary_table'}}" }, "label": "生成工资发放表" }]// 新版写法"actions": [{ "action": "OPEN_WEBSOCKET", "key": "generate_salary_table", "options": { "api": "common.calculate.api", "params": { "api_name": "private.apixxxxx", "params": { "arg1": "expression[FILTER_DCIT()]", "arg2": "测试参数" } } }, "label": "生成工资发放表"}] 2、云函数# -*- coding:utf-8 -*-# @CreateTime : 2019/12/5 17:53# @File : generate_salary_table.pyimport datetimeimport loggingimport timeimport errorsfrom core.extend.dynamic_plugin.customer_util import CustomerUtilfrom core.extend.sync_outer.services_base import BaseSyncOuterServiceclass generate_salary_table(object): def execute(self, param, notify=None): def update_state(_obj): if notify: notify(_obj) update_state(dict( progress=10, message='正在开始计算...' )) program_id = param.get("program_id") month = param.get("month") if not program_id or not month: update_state(dict( progress=100, message='未获取到薪酬项目和月份' )) return True version = 3 record_id = self.create_salary_send_record(month=month, program_id=program_id, version=version) sql_month = month.replace('-', '') # # 薪酬项目集合 # salary_item_list = self.get_salary_item(program_id=program_id) # if len(salary_item_list) < 1: # logging.info(u"BaiGuoYuanTable_薪酬方案下program_id:{};薪酬项目为空".format(program_id)) # return # 获取已封存的人员id employee_id_list, employee_count = self.get_employee_id_list(program_id=program_id, month=month) logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTable|employee_count|{}".format(employee_count)) if employee_count < 1: update_state(dict( progress=100, message='没有要处理的人员' )) return True delay_employee_id = self.get_delay_employee_id(month=month) # logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTable|delay_employee_id|{}".format(delay_employee_id)) table_name = "EHRMDGZFFB" page_size = 300 page_count = int(employee_count / page_size) + 1 logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTable|page_count|{}".format(page_count)) try: for page_index in range(1, page_count + 1, 1): logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTable|page_index|{}".format(page_index)) update_state(dict( progress=10 + 80 / page_count * page_index, message='共{}页数据正在处理第{}页数据'.format(page_count, page_index) )) item_employee_id_list = employee_id_list[(page_index - 1) * page_size:page_index * page_size] salary_data_entry_list = self.get_SalaryDataEntry_data_list(program_id=program_id, month=month, employee_id_list=item_employee_id_list) # logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTable|salary_data_entry_list|{}".format(len(salary_data_entry_list))) bill_id_list = [] sql_list = [] for item_employee_id in item_employee_id_list: # logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTable|number|{}".format(number)) is_delay = 0 if item_employee_id in delay_employee_id: continue # 循环人员处理 # 获取该人员的所有薪酬项目数据 item_salary_data_entry_list = filter(lambda x: x.get("employee_id") == item_employee_id, salary_data_entry_list) for item_entry in item_salary_data_entry_list: # 循环该人员的薪酬项目数据生成SQL # 员工的薪酬项目要细分,会存在两个单位的数据,然后按照部门在进行汇总 ehrmdgz_id = "FFB{}{}{}{}".format(item_entry.get("department").get('number'), sql_month, item_entry.get("employee").get("number"), item_entry.get("ProgramItem").get('number') ) if ehrmdgz_id in bill_id_list: continue bill_id_list.append(ehrmdgz_id) # 获取该薪酬项目program_item_id所有的数据 new_item_salary_data_entry_list = filter( lambda x: x.get("program_item_id") == item_entry.get("program_item_id"), item_salary_data_entry_list) # 然后按照部门在进行汇总 new_salaryDataEntry_list = map( lambda x: x.get("value") if x.get("depart_id") == item_entry.get("depart_id") else 0, new_item_salary_data_entry_list) salary_list_value = reduce(lambda x, y: x + y, new_salaryDataEntry_list) sql_dict = { "ehrmdgz_gzffqj": sql_month, "ehrmdgz_ygbh": item_entry.get("employee").get("number"), "EHRMDGZ_UPDATE": time.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S"), "ehrmdgz_dwbh": item_entry.get("unit").get('number'), "ehrmdgz_dwmc": item_entry.get("unit").get('name'), "ehrmdgz_bmbh": item_entry.get("department").get('number'), "ehrmdgz_bmmc": item_entry.get("department").get('name'), "ehrmdgz_id": ehrmdgz_id, "ehrmdgz_gzxmbh": item_entry.get("ProgramItem").get('number'), "ehrmdgz_gzxmmc": item_entry.get("ProgramItem").get('name'), "ehrmdgz_xmje": salary_list_value, "EHRMDGZ_GKXMBH": item_entry.get("parent_class").get("number"), "EHRMDGZ_GKXMMC": item_entry.get("parent_class").get("name"), "SFHF": is_delay } sql = self.generate_insert_sql(sql_dict=sql_dict, table_name=table_name) sql_list.append(sql) self.insert_sql(sql_list=sql_list, bill_id_list=bill_id_list, table_name=table_name) except Exception as e: logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTableErrors|{}".format(e)) update_state(dict( progress=100, message='推送失败' )) pass self.edit_salary_send_record(id=record_id, version=version, status=1) logging.info("BaiGuoYuanTable|END") update_state(dict( progress=100, message='推送完成' )) return True def generate_insert_sql(self, sql_dict, table_name): """ 生成插入sql :param sql_dict: :return: """ str_column_name = "" str_column_value = "" for column, column_value in sql_dict.items(): # 生成SQL str_column_name += "{},".format(column) str_column_value += " '{}',".format(column_value) sql = " insert into {} ( {} ) values ( {} )".format(table_name, str_column_name[:-1], str_column_value[:-1]) return sql def posts.excerpt: 1.action链以下公式只在action链中使用
posts.text: 1.action链以下公式只在action链中使用 公式 含义 范围 实例 1 RES(‘key’) 根据传入的key值返回相应action的执行结果 RES(‘{被执行的action链最外层的key}_action’) 可获取到action的配置，一些简单action链参数控制可放在此处，然后action链取读取这里的参数。 RES(‘clicked_field’) 在点击单元格触发的action中获取点击单元格对应列定义的方法 全部 “expression[RES(‘test_list_err’)]” 2 SELECT_ITEM() 返回选中的数据。在单选模式下使用，返回的是单条数据。 如果action是operate_row或operate_default，也要使用这个公式获取选中项 list “expression[GET(SELECT_ITEM(), [‘department’, ‘name’])]” 3 SELECT_ITEMS() 返回选中的数据。在多选模式下使用，返回的是数组 list “expression[LIST_CONCAT(LIST_GET(SELECT_ITEMS(), [‘department’, ‘name’]))]” “expression[LIST_CONCAT(LIST_GET(SELECT_ITEMS(), ‘id’))]” 4 ENV() 返回环境变量， 可获取 filter_str, paging 等信息 全部 “expression[GET(ENV(), [‘model’])]” 5 AUTH() 当前账号信息 全部 “expression[‘Employee:’+GET(AUTH(), [‘employee’,’name’])]” 6 FILTER_DICT() 过滤条件 list “expression[GET(FILTER_DICT(), [‘date_’])]” 7 GET_LIST() 获取列表数据 list “expression[(GET_LIST()]” 8 FORM_DATA(‘key’) 获取表单上的具某个字段的值 info, view “expression[FORM_DATA(‘work_content’)]” 9 FORMINFO() 获取完整的表单数据 info “expression[ISBLANK(GET(FORMINFO(), [‘month’]))]” 10 TRANSLATE(key) 获取多语言key 全部 “expression[TRANSLATE(‘date’)]” 返回日期 2.逻辑运算公式 公式 含义 1 AND (val1, val2) 且运算 2 OR (val1, val2) 或运算 3 IF (condition, true_val, false_val) IF条件运算，condition表达式为真的时候返回true_val的表达式的值，为假时返回false_val表达式的值 4 EQ (num1, num2) 等于 5 NEQ (num1, num2) 不等于 6 GT (num1, num2) 大于 7 GTE (num1, num2) 大于等于 8 LT (num1, num2) 小于 9 LTE (num1, num2) 小于等于 3.数学运算 公式 含义 1 + 加 2 - 减 3 * 乘 4 / 除 5 % 取余运算 6 () 括号表达式，用于处理逻辑优先级 7 MIN = (num1, num2) 最小值，返回两个数字的最小值 8 MAX = (num1, num2) 最大值，返回两个数字的最大值 4.值判断 公式 含义 1 ISBLANK (val) 判断表达式的值是否为空白,是的话返回true,不是的话返回false 5.时间处理 公式 含义 1 NOW (format) 返回当天的日期字符串，默认格式为：yyyy-MM-DD， 可传入format获取对应格式的日期字符串 2 DATE_STR = (…args) 根据传入年月日生成时间值，如DATE(2022,02,22) 输出 ‘2022-02-22’,DATE(2022,02) 输出 ‘2022-02’, 3 DATETIME_STR = (…args) 根据传入年月日时分秒生成时间值，如DATETIME(2002,03,23,01,12,59) 输出：’2002-04-23 01:12:59’ 4 ADDMONTHS = (date, num) 返回输入时间加减月份后的时间, 如 ADDMONTHS(‘2022-02’, -3) 输出 ‘2021-11’, ADDMONTHS(‘2022-02-22’, 3) 输出 ‘2022-05-22’, 5 ADDDAYS = (date, num) 返回输入时间加减日期后的时间, 如 ADDDAYS(‘2022-02-22’, -3) 输出 ‘2021-02-19’, ADDDAYS(‘2022-02-22’, 3) 输出 ‘2022-02-25’, 6 YEAR (date) 返回输入日期的年份数字，不传参数默认为当年 7 MONTH (date) 返回输入日期的月份数字，不传参数默认为当月 8 DAY(date) 返回输入日期的日期数字，不传参数默认为当日 9 HOUR (date) 返回输入日期的小时数字，不传参数默认为当前小时 10 MINUTE (date) 返回输入日期的分钟数字，不传参数默认为当前分钟 11 SECOND (date) 返回输入日期的秒数字，不传参数默认为当前秒 6.list,info,view,base 通用的action 1.CALL_API 12345678910{ "key": "new", "action": "CALL_API", "options": { "api": "user.access.control.add.employee", "params": { "employee_id": "expression[LIST_GET(RES('dialog'),'id')]" } }} 123456789101112{ "action": "CALL_API", "key": "call_emp_tt", "label": "测试1", "options": { "api": "hcm.model.get", "params": { "model": "Employee", "id_": "expression[GET(SELECT_ITEM(), ['id'])]" } }} 2.OPEN_WEBSOCKET - 通用websocket action 3.COMMON_LIST_DIALOG - 打开list弹窗 12345678910111213141516{ "key": "action", "label": "接口调用按钮", "action": [{ "key": "sub_action3", "action": "COMMON_LIST_DIALOG", "options": { "component": "hc-tree-list-selector", // 左树右列表通用选择器 "selectorModel": "Employee", "title": "test", "selectorType": 2, "filter_dict": {} } } ]} 4.COMMON_INFO_DIALOG - 打开info弹窗 123456789{ "action": "COMMON_INFO_DIALOG", "key": "info_dialog", "options":{ "model": "OrgDepartment", "title": "expression['组织选择器']", "data": "expression[...]" }} 5.COMMON_VIEW_DIALOG - 打开view弹窗 1234567891011{ "action": "COMMON_VIEW_DIALOG", "key": "view_dialog", "options":{ "model": "OrgDepartment", "state": "xxxx", "params": { ... } }} 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566676869707172737475767778798081828384858687888990{ "key": "translate_data", "label": "多语言", "condition": "MULTI_ITEM", "action": [ { "key": "set_env", "action": "SET_ENV", "options": { "params": { "object_name": "LeaveItem" } } }, { "key": "params", "action": "SIMPLE_FORM", "options": { "title": "翻译信息", "meta": [ { "key": "i18n", "label": "语种", "component": "hc-super-selector", "options": { "selectorModel": "CompanyLanguages", "singleLine": true, "returnFormat": "object", "required": true, "selectorFilter": { "id": { "neq": "zh_cn" } } } }, { "key": "key", "component": "hc-super-selector", "label": "翻译字段", "options": { "selectorObject": "hcm.paas.object.field", "selectorType": 1, "singleLine": true, "returnFormat": "object", "required": true, "selectorFilter": { "model": "expression[GET(ENV(),['object_name'])]" } } } ] } }, { "key": "translate_list", "action": "COMMON_LIST_DIALOG", "options": { "title": "expression[`翻译数据（${GET(RES('params'),['i18n','name'])}）`]", "component": "hc-category-list-selector", "model": "HCMI18NData", "state": "bizDataTranslate", "filter_dict": { "object_id": "expression[LIST_GET(SELECT_ITEMS(),['id'])]", "object_name": "expression[GET(ENV(),['object_name'])]", "key": "expression[GET(RES('params'),['key','key'])]", "i18n": "expression[GET(RES('params'),['i18n','id'])]" }, "selectorType": 0 } }, { "key": "save_i18n", "action": "CALL_API", "options": { "api": "hcm.model.action.params", "params": { "action": "save_i18n_data", "model": "HCMI18NData", "params": { "object_name": "expression[GET(ENV(),['object_name'])]", "i18n": "expression[GET(RES('params'),['i18n','id'])]", "field": "expression[GET(RES('params'),['key','key'])]", "data": "expression[RES('translate_list')]" } } } } ]} 7.GO_STATE 12345678910111213{ "action": "GO_STATE", "key": "state", "label": "跳转", "options": { "state": "common_model_list", "params": { "model": "Employee", "filter_dict": {} }, "open_new_page": true/false //是否打开新页签 }} 8.SET_ENV 12将变量存在控制器环境变量中func中 SCOPE.customEnvironmentParams中可以访问到SET_ENV里面设置的变量 12345678910111213141516{ "key": "set_env", "label": "保存环境变量", "hide": false, "action": [ { "key": "set_env", "action": "SET_ENV", "options": { "params": { "test": "expression[DATETIME_STR()]" } } } ]} 9.SHOW_WARNING 123456789{ "key": "show_warning", "action": "SHOW_WARNING", "options": { "content": "testtttttttt", "level": "warning/error/success(默认warning)", "waiting": 2000 }} 10.CLOSE 关闭弹窗,浏览器后退动作 12345678{ "key": "close", "action": "CLOSE", "options": { "status": "resolve"|"reject" "params": { ... }//你想要resolve或者reject回去的数据 }} 7.list页面专有action方法 1.CLEAR_SELECTED - 清除列表选中项12345{ "key": "clearselect", "label": "清除选择项", "action": "CLEAR_SELECTED"} 2.REFRESH1234{ "key": "refresh", "action": "REFRESH"} 8.info层专有action方法 1.SET_FORM -设置表单字段值12345678910111213{ "actions": [{ "label": "赋值按钮", "key": "set_form", "action": "SET_FORM", "options": { "params": { "number": "6666666", # field字段key:值 "description": "expression[GET(LIST_GET([{'name': 'cat'}, {'name': 'dog'}], 'name', 'name:dog'), [0])]" } } }]} 9.在action链中使用func函数的action12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152{ "key": "approve", "sequence": 1, "label": "【发送培训短信通知】", "action": [ { "key": "confirm", "action": "CONFIRM", "hide": true, "options": { "content": "确认要发送培训通知？" } }, { "action": "SIMPLE_FORM", "key": "return_simple_form", "hide": true, "options": { "title": "通知内容", "meta": [ { "component": "hc-text-area", "key": "train_notice" } ], "data": { "train_notice": "测试" } } }, { "key": "execute_dynamic", "action": "CALL_API", "hide": true, "options": { "api": "private.xxxx", "params": { "item": "expression[SELECT_ITEMS()]", "content": "expression[GET(RES('return_simple_form'),['train_notice'])]" } } }, { "key": "show_message", "action": "SHOW_WARNING", "hide": true, "options": { "content": "expression[RES('execute_dynamic')]" } } ]} 10.列表操作123数据说明LIST_GET(GET_LIST(),'name') =["管理员1","管理员2","管理员2","管理员3"]LIST_GET(GET_LIST(),'gender') =["男","女","男","女"] 1.LIST_VALUES - 获取LIST值中特定的值 123456* @param {*} _list 列表 [{'id':1, 'name':1}, {'id': 2,'name':2},{'id':3,'name':3}]* @param {*} _key 字段名称 name* @param {*} _filter 过滤条件 name:1+2;id:1* @param {*} _default 默认值* return [{ id: 1, name: 1 }] 123456789101112// 过滤name为管理员1的数据，没有数据返回aaaa{ "key": "show_warning", "sequence": 1, "label": "TTT测试", "action": "SHOW_WARNING", "options": { "content": "expression[LIST_VALUES(GET_LIST(),['name'], 'name:管理员1', 'aaaa')]", "level": "warning", "waiting": 2000 }} 2.LIST_MAP - 映射LIST的值列表 12345* @param {*} _list 列表 [{'id':1, 'name':1}, {'id': 2,'name':2},{'id':3,'name':3}]* @param {*} _map 字段名称映射 label:name;value:id* @param {*} _filter 过滤条件 name:1+2;id:1* return [{ label: 1, value: 1 }] 123// 将原数据key:name改为empname,写几个key最终会显示几个key，下面例子只映射一个key，最终返回数据只会有一个值"expression[LIST_MAP(GET_LIST(),'empname:name', 'name:管理员1')]" 3.LIST_GET - 获取LIST值的列表 123* @param {*} _list 列表 [{'id':1, 'name':1}, {'id': 2,'name':2},{'id':3,'name':3}]* @param {*} _key 字段名称 name* @param {*} _filter 过滤条件 name:1+2;id:1 12// 返回一个name列表"expression[LIST_GET(GET_LIST(),'name', 'name:管理员1')]" 4.LIST_COUNT - 获取LIST值合计 123* @param {*} _list 列表 [{'id':1, 'name':1}, {'id': 2,'name':2},{'id':3,'name':3}]* @param {*} _key 字段名称 name* @param {*} _filter 过滤条件 1"expression[LIST_COUNT(GET_LIST(),'id','gender:男性')]" 5.DE_DU - 列表去重 1@param {*} _list [1, 2, 3, 1] * return [1, 2, 3] 1"expression[DE_DU(LIST_GET(GET_LIST(),'gender'))]" 6.list_sorted - 对list数据简单排序 12345678* @param {*} _list 列表 [{'id':1, 'name':1}, {'id': 2,'name':2},{'id':3,'name':3}]* @param {*} sorts_fields 字段 ['id', 'name']* @param {*} reverse 默认正序，true，反序** return [{'id':1, 'name':1}, {'id': 2,'name':2},{'id':3,'name':3}]"expression[list_sorted(GET_LIST(),['id', 'name'], reverse=false)]" 7.LIST_COMBINE - 列表按字段进行接接 1234* @param {*} _list 列表值 [{'id':1, 'name':1}, {'id': 2,'name':2},{'id':3,'name':3}]* @param {*} _fields 字段值 'id|name'"expression[LIST_COMBINE(GET_LIST(),'id|name')]" 8.LIST_CONCAT - 单值列表字符拼接公式 1234* @param {*} _list 列表值 ['ha', 'he', 'hi']* @param {*} _char '-'"expression[LIST_CONCAT(GET_LIST(),'-')]" 9.LIST_INCLUDE - 判断_value是否在列表中 12345* @param {*} _list 列表值 ['ha', 'he', 'hi']* @param {*} _value 'ha'* return true"expression[LIST_INCLUDE(LIST_GET(GET_LIST(),'name'), '管理员1')]" 10.FINDBYINDEX - 获取列表的第n项 12345* @param {*} _list 列表值 ['a', 'b', 'c']* @param {*} _index 0* return 'a'"expression[FINDBYINDEX(LIST_GET(GET_LIST(),'name'),1)]", 11.ISINCLUDED - 元素包含在列表中 123456* @param {*} val* @param {*} list* @returns"expression[ISINCLUDED('管理员1', LIST_GET(GET_LIST(),'name'))]" 11.字符串操作 公式 描述 1 STR_SLICE (‘str’, 0, ) 字符切割，返回新字符串 2 STR_SPLIT (str, _char) 分隔符字符串，返回分割后的字符串数 3 STR_INCLUDES(str, substr) 字符串包含 4 TO_STRING(pre_str) 转为字符串 12.字典操作 公式 描述 例子 1 OBJ_MERGE (obj_1, obj_2) 合并两个obj expression[ OBJ_MERGE ({‘name’:1}, {‘id’:2})] 2 OBJ_PICK (obj, key_arr) 创建一个从 object 中选中的属性的对象 “expression[ OBJ_PICK ({‘name’:1, ‘id’:2}, ‘name’)]” 3 JSON_STRINGIFY 返回字符串。 “expression[ JSON_STRINGIFY ({‘name’:1, ‘id’:2})]” 4 JSON_PARSE 只会解析 JSON 数据，不会执行代码，相对安全 “expression[ JSON_PARSE ({‘name’:1, ‘id’:2})]” 13.其他 公式 描述 1 GET(EMPLOYEE(), [‘name’]) 指获取环境变量中employee.name的值 2 TOARRAY(1,2,3) 生成数组的公式 3 TRANSLATE(key)多语言翻译的方法 4 MD5(str) MD5加密 5 SHA1(str) SHA1加密

posts.text: 下载二维码 1、上传套打模板 配置模版1[系统设置] - [基础服务] - [套打管理] - [套打管理] - [模版上传] 12注意:1、模版标识 - download_qrcode: 模版样式 2、云函数 - 下载分组二维码 - eval_download_qrcode_ eval_download_qrcode_s(BasePrivateApiService): """ 动态私有OpenAPI 使用方法 """ def execute(self, **kwargs): try: if kwargs.get("is_new"): template_id = kwargs.get("data", {}).get("id") _template = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.get", {"model": "PrintBillTemplate", "id_": template_id}) _bill = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.get", {"model": "PrintBillList", "id_": _template.get("bill_id")}) bill_key = _bill.get("bill_key") model_id = bill_key[:-1] if bill_key.endswith(":") else bill_key else: model_id = kwargs.get("data").get("bill_key") model_id = model_id[:-1] # 获取所有二维码列表 source_data, actInfo = self.get_qr_code_url_list(kwargs.get('itemId')) # 分组 source_data = self.group_url_list(source_data) # 获取每个分组套打文件绝对路径及文件名 print_file_dict = {} for group_name, url_list in source_data.items(): file_index = self.get_print_index(model_id, group_name, url_list) file_abs_path = DocumentUtil.generate_file_path(index=file_index, file_type='docx') print_file_dict[f'{group_name}.docx'] = file_abs_path # 合并为压缩包 zip_data = self.files_to_zip_in_memory(print_file_dict) document_info = self.get_zip_file(zip_data, actInfo.get("name")) return {"success": True, "file_index": document_info.get('index'), "msg": ""} except Exception as e: self.record(traceback.format_exc()) raise e def record(self, content, type=3): company_id = CustomerUtil.get_current_context().company.id category = self.__class__.__name__ ModelUtil.create('SyncOuterRecord', { "company_id": company_id, "name": category, "category": category, "type": type, "content": content, "update_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") }) def get_qr_code_url_list(self, item_id, **kwargs): urlList = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("eval.scorer.get.url.list", {"activity_id": item_id}, request=self.request) date = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") actInfo = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.get", {"model": "EvalActivity", "id_": item_id}) for url in urlList: url.update({ "actName": actInfo['name'], "groupName": url['name'], "d": date, "image_qrCode": base64.b64encode( CustomerUtil.call_open_api("recruit.get.qr.code.url", {"url": url['url']})).decode('utf-8'), "pic_reduce_rate": 1 }) return urlList, actInfo def get_print_index(self, model_id, file_name, source_data): return CustomerUtil.call_open_api("get.print.index", { "params": { "model_id": model_id, "print_type": "common", "source_data": source_data, "file_name": file_name, "view_type": "docx", "multi": "single" } }).get("index") def group_url_list(self, source_data): return_url_list = collections.defaultdict(list) for url in source_data: group_name = url.get("name") return_url_list[group_name].append(url) return dict(return_url_list) def files_to_zip_in_memory(self, file_path_dict): """ 将多个文件合并成zip包的二进制数据（不写入磁盘） Args: :param file_path_dict: {文件名:文件绝对路径} Returns: bytes: zip文件的二进制数据 """ # 创建内存缓冲区 zip_buffer = io.BytesIO() with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_buffer, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf: added_count = 0 for file_name, file_path in file_path_dict.items(): # 检查文件是否存在 if not DocumentUtil.file_exists(file_path): self.record(f"警告: 文件不存在，跳过: {file_path}") continue # 使用文件名作为zip中的路径 zipf.write(file_path, file_name) added_count += 1 self.record(f"已添加: {file_name}") # 获取二进制数据 zip_buffer.seek(0) # 将指针移回开头 zip_data = zip_buffer.getvalue() self.record(f"已生成zip包的二进制数据") self.record(f"包含 {added_count} 个文件") self.record(f"数据大小: {len(zip_data)} 字节") return zip_data def get_zip_file(self, file_body, zip_name): file_name, file_index = DocumentUtil.save_document(file_body=file_body, file_type='zip') return ModelUtil.create("Document", {"index": file_index, "source_name": f"{zip_name}.zip", "file_type": 'zip', "owner_id": self.context.employee.id, "status": 1, "create_date": datetime.datetime.now(), "check_item": {}, "doc_type": 81518}) 3、云函数 - 下载二维码 - posts.text: 表单-链接字段 1.hc-sys-link 组件：跳转内部state或者外部网站 字段名 字段描述 实例 url 跳转的外部网址注意：url必须包含采用的网络协议，如http，https url: “http://www.baidu.com“ state 要跳转的state（支持配置function） state: “employee” // state: “common_model_list” // state: “=function(){return ‘common_model_list’}” params 跳转state时的参数 params: “=function(){return {id: SCOPE.base_form.data.employee_id,’mode’:’edit’}}” // params: {“model”: “Employee”} // params: “=function(){return {“model”:”Employee”}}” 2.实例1： state=模型 - params=参数1234567891011121314151617181920212223"fields":[ { "key": "field_29", "label": "人员资料", "sequence": 15, "component": "hc-sys-link", "options": { "singleLine": true, "readOnly": true, "required": false, "placeholder": "人员简历", "width": "col-6", "hide": false, "data_type": "link", "default": { "label": "人员资料", "state": "employee", "params": "=function(){return {id: SCOPE.base_form.data.employee_id,'mode':'edit'}}" }, "force_assign": true } }] 3.实例2：state=场景 - params=模型 123456789101112131415161718192021222324"fields": [ { "component": "hc-sys-link", "label": "测试超链接", "key": "test_link", "options": { "target": ["pc", "mobile"], "force_assign": true, "singleLine": true, "hide": false, "default": { "state": "common_model_list", "params": { "model": "Announce" }, "label": "test" }, "required": false, "width": "col-6", "readOnly": false, "placeholder": "请输入测试超链接" } } ]

posts.text: 云函数 - 过滤条件 1.命名规范 - 云函数对应名称： 120_condition_recruitPosition(命名规则:{company_id}condition{name}) 字段 属性 描述 query_ 过滤条件 可以在已有过滤条件基础增加过滤条件 condition_context 环境变量 参数详细数据，参考以下： 1234567condition_context = dict( company_id=company_id, employee_id=context.employee.id if context and context.employee else None, user_id=context.user.id if context and context.user else None, context=context, filter_dict=kwargs.get('filter_dict') ) 2.云函数 - 3055_condition_ttt2222 12345678910111213141516171819class DynamicCondition(DynamicConditionBase): """ 用于列表添加动态过滤条件 使用示例:"conditions": {"job_info.employee_category_id": "dynamic#employee_category_dynamic_condition"} """ def condition(self, query_, field_, condition_context): result = self.call_open_api("hcm.model.list", param={"model": "emp_role_detail", "filter_dict": { "employee_id": self.plugin_context.employee.id}})['list'] job_step_value = [0] if len(result) > 0: if result[0]['emp_type'] == 1: # 是什么类型人员 job_step_value = [546, 547, 548] elif result[0]['emp_type'] == 2: job_step_value = [549, 550, 551] else: job_step_value = [0] query_ = query_.filter(field_.in_(job_step_value)) return query_ 3.conditions过滤条件，限定取数范围 123456789101112131415161718192021221.固定条件过滤：{ "conditions": { "id": { "notin": [ 1, 2] } }}2.云函数过滤：{ "conditions": { "id": { "dynamic": { "name": "recruitPosition", "params": { "dynamic_job_id": "=dynamic_job_id" } } } }} 4.云函数 - 120_condition_recruitPosition 123456789101112131415161718class DynamicCondition(object): def condition(self, query_, field_, condition_context): result = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.list", param={"model": "emp_role_detail", "filter_dict": { "employee_id": condition_context.get('employee_id')}})['list'] job_step_value = [0] if len(result) > 0: if result[0]['emp_type'] == 1: # 是什么类型人员 job_step_value = [546, 547, 548] elif result[0]['emp_type'] == 2: job_step_value = [549, 550, 551] else: job_step_value = [0] query_ = query_.filter(field_.in_(job_step_value)) logging.info("condition:{}:{}".format(condition_context.get('employee_id'), job_step_value)) return query_ 5.使用open-api过滤 1234567891011// 元数据配置{ "conditions": { "id": { "dynamic": { "name": "qinyucun_test_cont", "plugin_type": "open_api" } } }} 123456789101112131415# 云函数class PrivateAPIService(BasePrivateApiService): """ 动态私有OpenAPI 使用方法 """ def execute(self, **kwargs): context = kwargs.get("context") company_id = kwargs.get("company_id") _query = kwargs.get("_query") _field = kwargs.get("_field") condition_context = kwargs.get("condition_context") return _query

posts.text: hcm发送内部通知，待办，已办信息 - message.send.message1、字段讲解 字段 说明 is_task_done 0：通知，1：待办，2：已办 sender 消息发送人的人员ID，如果要设置为系统消息，sender:0 ，非必传 to 消息接收人人员ID，必传 content 消息内容。必传 state 跳转页面，比如页面是：common_model_List?model=ModelReport，state:common_model_list，必传 param 跳转页面的参数，比如页面是：common_model_List?model=ModelReport&meta_state=test,param是‘?’号之后的参数:{“model”:”ModelReport”,”meta_state”:”test”} ，必传 level 消息等级，默认是0，大于1000是高级别消息，非必传 url 用于集成端点击消息跳转的地址，正常来说是有系统自动根据state,param两个参数自动构造出来的，可以根据需要自己构造传入，非必传 extend_dict 消息内扩展数据，用于一些特殊的设置，非必传 msg_type 消息类别，系统内的消息类别，自定义，长度限制在20个字符串，必传 message_category 外部消息类别，用于控制外部消息发送message_control.json里边的配置，最好和msg_type一致，如果是要发送系统已存在的系统类别，需要查看当前系统消息是什么类别，必传 title_id 消息标题，消息右上角展示的标签，传入MessagezTitle的数据ID，根据实际需要传入，必传 2、is_task_done1230：通知1：待办2：已办 3、message_category 讲解 message_control.json - emp_list = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.count",{ "group_by": [ "mobile" ], "count_by": [ "id" ], "model": "ContactInformation", "filter_dict": {}, "page_size": 200000 })['list'] mobile_list = [x.get('mobile') for x in emp_list] return mobile_list def log(self, log_content): log_info = {"log_type": str('emp_test'), "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-0d %H:%M:%S'), "content": str(log_content)} CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", {"model": "dynamic_log", "info": log_info})

执行主要的数据处理流程，包括获取数据、转换格式、处理不同组织类型、构建层级结构和树形结构等操作。 如果在处理过程中出现异常，会记录异常信息并重新抛出异常。 """ try: # 获取原始数据 _data = self.get_data() _data_from_api = _data.get('data', []) #_data_from_api=[x for x in _data_from_api if x["ORGEH"]=="00001055"] self.log(len(_data_from_api)) #return _data_from_api #dep_list=CustomerUtil.call_open_api('org.department.list', { #"filter_dict":{ #"origin_id":{"child_include":16257544}, #"enabled":[True,False], #"child_include_type":-2}, #"page_index":1, #"page_size":99999, #"extra_property":{ #"state":"all" #} #})["list"] #dep_list_ids=[x["number"] for x in dep_list] if _data_from_api: # 对从API获取的数据进行格式转换 data_from_api=[] error_batch=[] for i in [x for x in _data_from_api if not x['SHORT']]: inf={} inf={ "u_data": json.dumps(i, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败", "u_date": self.today, "error_msg":"单位简称【SHORT】为空" } error_batch.append(inf) if error_batch: CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.create.batch', { "model": "U_organize_data_reception", "info_list": error_batch }) _data_from_api = [x for x in _data_from_api if x['SHORT'] != ""] self.log(f"len--{len(_data_from_api)}") for item in _data_from_api: try: org_type = int(item.get("ORGTP")) if item.get("ORGTP","") else 10 data_item = { "parent_id": item["ORGUP"], "number": item["ORGEH"], "name": item["SHORT"], "org_full_name": item["STEXT"], "state": item["STATE"], "orderno": item['PRIOX'], "begin_date": f"{item['BEGDA'][0:4]}-{item['BEGDA'][4:6]}-{item['BEGDA'][6:8]}" if item['BEGDA'] else "1900-01-01" , # f"{item['BEGDA'][0:4]}-{item['BEGDA'][4:6]}-{item['BEGDA'][6:8]}", "end_date": "2199-12-31" if item["ENDDA"] == "99991231" else f"{item['ENDDA'][0:4]}-{item['ENDDA'][4:6]}-{item['ENDDA'][6:8]}", "org_type": org_type, # 确保org_type是整数 "u_deptlevel": self.ONBCJ_TXT.get(item.get('ONBCJ',"")) if org_type == 20 else "" } data_from_api.append(data_item) except Exception : self.log(traceback.format_exc()) self.log(f"_item---{item}") # self.log(f"data--{data_from_api[:10]}") # 根据组织类型添加'model'字段 for item in data_from_api: if item['org_type'] == 10: item['model'] = 'OrgUnit' elif item['org_type'] == 20: item['model'] = 'OrgDepartment' # 处理parent_id为空的情况（根组织），只执行model_edit接口 self.log(f"data2--{data_from_api[:10]}") # self.log(f"parent_id--{[x for x in data_from_api if x['parent_id']=='00000001']}") # return for item in data_from_api: if item['parent_id'] == "00000001": self.log(f"11111--{item}") existing_id = self.transfer_number_to_id(item['number'], item['model']) if existing_id: # 构建要更新的信息字典，这里示例只包含部分字段，可根据实际需求修改 update_info = { "org_type": item.get('org_type', 10), "name": item.get('name', ''), "number": item.get('number', ''), "org_full_name": item.get('org_full_name', '') } try: # 根据模型和ID更新数据 self.model_edit(item['model'], existing_id, update_info,'') # 创建数据接收记录，表示更新成功 self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today}) except Exception as e: # 记录异常信息 self.log(traceback.format_exc()) # 创建数据接收记录，表示更新失败 self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败", "u_date": self.today, "error_msg":str(e)}) break # 构建层级结构并获取组织信息映射字典 hierarchy, org_map = self.build_hierarchy(data_from_api) # 已知根节点的ID为17658273 root_id = 16257544 # 构建树形结构 self.build_tree(root_id, hierarchy, org_map) except Exception as e: # 记录异常信息并重新抛出异常 self.log(f"中断异常--{traceback.format_exc()}") raise e def ensure_parent_exists(self, parent_number, model, hierarchy, org_map): """ 确保上级组织存在。如果上级组织的ID不存在，尝试根据提供的信息构建并新增上级组织。 返回上级组织的ID，如果无法找到或创建上级组织则返回False。 """ parent_id = self.transfer_number_to_id(parent_number, model) if not parent_id: # 如果上级组织ID不存在，尝试获取上级组织的信息 parent_info = org_map.get(parent_number) if parent_info: try: # 创建上级组织 self.model_create(parent_info['model'], parent_info) # 创建数据接收记录，表示创建成功 self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(parent_info, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today}) except Exception as e: # 记录异常信息 self.log(traceback.format_exc()) # 创建数据接收记录，表示创建失败 self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(parent_info, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败", "u_date": self.today, "error_msg":str(e) }) parent_id = parent_info['id'] org_map[parent_info['number']] = parent_info # 更新组织信息映射字典 if 16257544 not in hierarchy: hierarchy[16257544] = [] hierarchy[16257544].append(parent_info['number']) else: # self.log(f"Parent organization not found: {parent_number}") return False return parent_id def transfer_number_to_id(self, number, model): """ 将组织的编号转换为对应的ID。 通过调用hcm_model_list接口，根据提供的模型名和编号过滤条件来获取对应的组织信息，并返回其ID。 如果未找到对应的组织信息，则返回None。 """ result = self.hcm_model_list( model=model, filter_dict={ "number": number }, page_size=9999, page_index=1, only_list=True )["list"] if result: return result[0].get("id") return None def build_hierarchy(self, data_list): """ 构建组织数据的层级结构，并返回层级结构字典和组织信息映射字典。 首先将所有数据的编号转换为ID，并处理不存在ID的组织（尝试创建）。 然后根据组织的父子关系构建层级结构。 """ hierarchy = {} org_map = {} # 存储转换后的组织ID和其信息 # 遍历数据列表，将编号转换为ID，并处理不存在ID的情况 for data in data_list: org_id = self.transfer_number_to_id(data['number'], data['model']) if org_id: data['id'] = org_id # 将转换后的ID添加到数据中 model = 'OrgUnit' if data['org_type'] == 10 else 'OrgDepartment' data['model'] = model org_map[data['number']] = data # 使用编号作为键存储组织信息 else: # 如果没有找到ID，表示组织不存在，需要新增 parent_id = self.ensure_parent_exists(data['parent_id'], data['model'], hierarchy, org_map) if parent_id: data['parent_id'] = parent_id try: self.model_create(data['model'], data) self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today}) except Exception as e: self.log(traceback.format_exc()) self.log(e) self.log(f"{json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)}--{self.today}---{'失败'}---{e}") self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception",{"u_data": json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败","u_date": self.today,"error_msg":str(e)}) continue data['id'] = self.transfer_number_to_id(data['number'], data['model']) # 更新ID org_map[data['number']] = data # 更新组织信息映射字典 self.log("org_map finish") # 构建层级结构，根据组织的父子关系将组织编号添加到层级结构字典中 for number, data in org_map.items(): parent_id = self.transfer_number_to_id(data['parent_id'], data['model']) if parent_id: if 16257544 not in hierarchy: hierarchy[16257544] = [] hierarchy[16257544].append(number) # 打印层级结构字典以检查层级关系 # self.log("Hierarchy dictionary:") # for parent, children in hierarchy.items(): # self.log(f"Parent {parent}: Children {children}") self.log("build hierarchy finish") return hierarchy, org_map def build_tree(self, parent_id, hierarchy, org_map, level=0): """ 递归构建树形结构，根据层级结构和组织信息映射字典来创建树形结构。 限制递归深度为10层，防止无限递归。 对于每个节点，检查数据状态并进行相应的数据变更操作，同时确保数据完整性。 如果节点不存在对应的ID，则尝试创建新的组织。 """ if level > 10: # 限制递归深度，防止无限递归 return [] tree = [] if parent_id in hierarchy: for child_number in hierarchy[parent_id]: child_data = org_map.get(child_number) if child_data: # 检查数据状态，如果为0则进行数据变更操作 if child_data['state'] == '0': self.update_data_when_state_zero(child_data) continue # 再次检查数据完整性，确保包含必要字段 required_fields = ['begin_date', 'name'] if not all(field in child_data for field in required_fields): self.log(f"子节点数据不完整: {child_data}, 缺少必要字段") continue child_info = { "begin_date": child_data.get('begin_date', ''), "establishment_date": child_data.get('end_date', ''), "parent_id": parent_id, # 使用传递进来的parent_id "org_type": child_data.get('org_type', 0), "u_deptlevel": child_data.get('u_deptlevel', ''), "name": child_data.get('name', ''), "orderno": child_data.get('orderno', ''), "number": child_data.get('number', ''), "org_full_name": child_data.get('org_full_name', '') } existing_id = self.transfer_number_to_id(child_data['number'], child_data['model']) if existing_id: #continue #存在的跳过 child_info_copy=copy.deepcopy(child_info) temp_begin=child_info['begin_date'] del child_info['begin_date'] del child_info['establishment_date'] try: self.model_edit(child_data['model'], existing_id, child_info,temp_begin) self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(child_info, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today}) except Exception as e: if "不能通过修订修改上级组织!" in str(e): try: self.model_update(child_data['model'], existing_id, child_info_copy) except Exception as e2: self.log(traceback.format_exc()) self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(child_info_copy, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败", "u_date": self.today, "error_msg":str(e2)}) else: self.log(traceback.format_exc()) self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(child_info, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败", "u_date": self.today, "error_msg":str(e)}) else: # 如果没有找到ID，表示组织不存在，需要新增 # self.log(f"No ID found for number: {child_data['number']}, creating new organization.") try: self.model_create(child_data['model'], child_info) # self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(child_info, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today}) except Exception as e: self.log(traceback.format_exc()) self.model_create("U_organize_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(child_info, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败", "u_date": self.today, "error_msg":str(e)}) child_tree = self.build_tree(existing_id or child_data['id'], hierarchy, org_map, level + 1) if child_tree: child_data['children'] = child_tree tree.append(child_data) else: self.log(f"Child data not found for number: {child_number}") self.log("build tree finish") return tree @staticmethod def hcm_model_list(model, filter_dict, **kwargs): """ 调用hcm.model.list接口获取符合条件的模型数据列表。 根据传入的参数设置查询条件，包括模型名、过滤条件、分页信息、字段筛选、状态筛选、关系查询、排序等。 返回接口调用的结果。 """ page_index = kwargs.get("page_index") or 1 page_size = kwargs.get("page_size") or 9999 param = { "model": model, "filter_dict": filter_dict, "page_size": page_size, "page_index": page_index, "extra_property": { "role": "all", "only_list": True } } fields = kwargs.get("fields") if fields: fields = [{"key": item, "field": [item]} for item in fields] param["extra_property"]["fields"] = fields state = kwargs.get("state") if state: param["extra_property"]["state"] = state relations = kwargs.get("relations") if relations: param["extra_property"]["relations"] sorts = kwargs.get("sorts") if relations: param["extra_property"]["sorts"] = sorts only_list = kwargs.get("only_list") if relations: param["extra_property"]["only_list"] = only_list result = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.list", param) return result def update_data_when_state_zero(self, child_data): """ 当数据状态为0时进行数据更新操作，调用org.department.revoke接口根据ID和开始日期变更模型数据。 """ self.depart_revoke(child_data['id'], child_data.get('end_date', "")) def get_data(self): """ 从指定的URL获取组织性能相关的数据，发送POST请求，目前设置的请求数据为空。 返回获取到的响应文本内容。 """ url = "http://192.168.1.22/hana/organization/getPerformanceOrganization" today = datetime.date.today().strftime('%Y%m%d') payload = json.dumps({ "startDate": today,#"20241127", "endDate": today }) # payload = "" headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } response = requests.request("POST", url, headers=headers, data=payload) return response.json() @staticmethod def model_create(model, info): """ 调用hcm.model.create接口给指定模型插入一条数据，传入模型名和要插入的数据信息。 返回接口调用的结果。 """ return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.create', {"model": model, "info": info}) @staticmethod def model_edit(model, id_, info,temp_begin): """ 调用hcm.model.edit接口根据ID修改指定模型的数据，传入模型名、ID和要修改的数据信息。 返回接口调用的结果。 """ try: CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.edit', {"model": model, "id_": id_, "info": info}) except Exception as e: if "修订修改上级组织" in e: CustomerUtil.call_open_api("org.department.batch.update", { "info_list":[{ "id":id_, "begin_date":temp_begin, "parent_id":info['parent_id'] }] }) # return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.edit', {"model": model, "id_": id_, "info": info}) @staticmethod def model_update(model, id_, info): """ 调用hcm.model.edit接口根据ID修改指定模型的数据，传入模型名、ID和要修改的数据信息。 返回接口调用的结果。 """ return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('org.department.revoke', {"model": model, "id_": id_, "info": info}) @staticmethod def depart_revoke(id_, begin_date): """ 调用org.department.revoke接口根据ID和开始日期变更模型数据，传入对象ID和生效日期。 返回接口调用的结果。 """ return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('org.department.revoke', {'object_id': id_, 'effdt': begin_date}) def log(self, log_content): """ 记录日志信息，创建一个包含日志类型、创建时间和日志内容的字典， 然后调用hcm.model.create接口将日志信息插入到名为'dynamic_log'的模型中。 """ log_info = {"log_type": str('org_recive'), "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-0d %H:%M:%S'), "content": str(log_content)} CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", {"model": "dynamic_log", "info": log_info})

"STATE": "1", "ORGEH": "test123"}] # 对获取的数据进行格式转换，准备用于后续处理 if data_from_api: # self.log(len(data_from_api)) # self.log([x for x in data_from_api if x['STEXT'] and x['STEXT']=="离退休"][:10]) # return #self.log(data_from_api[0]['STEXT']) #self.log([x for x in data_from_api if x['STEXT'] and x['PLANS'] and x['ORGEH'] in dep_num_list]) erro_batch=[] for i in [x for x in data_from_api if not x['STEXT'] or not x['PLANS'] or not x['ORGEH'] or x["ORGEH"] not in dep_num_list]: inf={} inf={ "u_data": json.dumps(i, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败", "u_date":self.today, "error_msg":f"无编号【{i['PLANS']}】或名称【{i['STEXT']}】或所属部门【{i['ORGEH']}】不在系统中" } erro_batch.append(inf) if erro_batch: CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create.batch", { "model": "U_position_data_reception", "info_list": erro_batch }) # data_from_api=[x for x in data_from_api if x['STEXT'] and x['PLANS'] and x['PLANS'] not in pos_nums and x["ORGEH"] in dep_num_list] data_from_api=[x for x in data_from_api if x['STEXT'] and x['PLANS'] and x["ORGEH"] in dep_num_list] # self.log(f"step {n} 无【STEXT】--{len([x for x in data_from_api if not x['STEXT']])}") # self.log(f"step {n} 无【PLANS】--{len([x for x in data_from_api if not x['PLANS']])}") # self.log(f"step {n} 无【ORGEH】--{len([x for x in data_from_api if not x['ORGEH']])}") self.log(f"data_from_api--{len(data_from_api)}") data_form_api2 = [ { "parent_id": dep_num_dict.get(item["ORGEH"]),#self.transfer_number_to_id(item["ORGEH"], "OrgDepartment"), "u_org_num":item["ORGEH"], "number": item["PLANS"], "name": item["STEXT"]+'-'+item["PLANS"], "u_show_name": item["STEXT"], "state": item["STATE"], "orderno":item['PRIOX'], # 格式化开始日期，将类似'20241121'的格式转换为'2024-11-21'f"{item['BEGDA'][0:4]}-{item['BEGDA'][4:6]}-{item['BEGDA'][6:8]}" "begin_date": "1900-03-01", # 特殊处理结束日期，如果是'99991231'则设为'2199-12-31'，否则进行格式化 "end_date": "2199-12-31" if item["ENDDA"] == "99991231" else f"{item['ENDDA'][0:4]}-{item['ENDDA'][4:6]}-{item['ENDDA'][6:8]}", "org_type": 40 } for item in data_from_api ] # self.log(f"not----{len([x for x in data_form_api2 if not x['parent_id']])}") # nu=[x["number"] for x in [x for x in data_form_api2 if not x['parent_id']][:10]] # self.log([x for x in data_from_api if x["PLANS"] in nu]) # return data_form_api2 = [x for x in data_form_api2 if x['parent_id']] # 定义根节点的ID（这里假设根节点ID是固定的） # self.log(data_form_api2[:10]) self.log(f"data_form_api2--{len(data_form_api2)}") # self.log(f"data_form_api2--{data_form_api2}") # 遍历处理转换后的数据 for item in data_form_api2: found = False # for position in position_list: # 检查当前处理的数据在已存在岗位列表中是否存在 #if position["number"] == item["number"]: if position_dict.get(item["number"],""): found = True if item["state"] == "0": # 如果数据状态为0，调用depart_revoke方法根据岗位ID和结束日期撤销岗位 try: self.depart_revoke(position_dict[item["number"]], item["end_date"]) #self.model_create("U_position_data_reception",{"u_data":json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today}) except Exception : # 记录异常信息 self.log(traceback.format_exc()) # 创建数据接收记录，表示更新失败 self.model_create("U_position_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败","u_date":self.today,"u_number":item.get('number')}) else: # 如果数据状态不为0，准备编辑信息并调用model_edit方法修改岗位数据 edit_info = { "name": item["name"], "u_show_name": item["u_show_name"], "orderno":item['orderno'] } try: self.model_edit("OrgPosition", position_dict[item["number"]], edit_info) #self.model_create("U_position_data_reception",{"u_data":json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today}) except Exception as e: # 记录异常信息 self.log(traceback.format_exc()) # 创建数据接收记录，表示更新失败 self.model_create("U_position_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败","u_date":self.today,"error_msg":str(e),"u_number":item.get('number')}) # break if not found and item["state"] == "1": # 如果数据在已存在岗位列表中不存在且状态为1，准备创建信息并调用model_create方法创建新岗位 create_info = { "parent_id": item["parent_id"], "number": item["number"], "name": item["name"], "u_show_name": item["u_show_name"], "orderno":item['orderno'], "org_type": item["org_type"], "begin_date": item["begin_date"], "state": item["state"] } try: self.model_create("OrgPosition", create_info) self.model_create("U_position_data_reception",{"u_data":json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "成功","u_date":self.today,"u_number":item.get('number')}) except Exception as e : # 记录异常信息 self.log(traceback.format_exc()) # 创建数据接收记录，表示更新失败 self.model_create("U_position_data_reception", {"u_data": json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False), "u_state": "失败","u_date":self.today,"error_msg":str(e),"u_number":item.get('number')}) return {"status": "success", "message": "同步成功"} except Exception as e: # 记录异常信息并重新抛出异常 self.log(traceback.format_exc()) raise e def transfer_number_to_id(self, number, model): """ 将岗位编号转换为对应的ID。 :param number: 岗位编号 :param model: 模型名称（这里是"OrgDepartment"等相关模型） :return: 对应的岗位ID，如果未找到则返回None """ result = self.model_list({ "model": model, "filter_dict": { "number": number }, "page_size": 99999, "page_index": 1 })["list"] if result: return result[0].get("id") return None def get_data(self,num): """ 从指定的URL获取组织性能相关的数据（这里虽然定义了请求，但目前请求数据为空）。 返回获取到的响应文本内容。 """ result=[] for i in range(1,300): url = "http://192.168.1.22/hana/post/getPerformancePost" # today = datetime.date.today().strftime('%Y%m%d') payload = json.dumps({ "startDate": '20250101', "endDate": '20250924', "pageNum":i, "pageSize":1000 }) #payload = "" headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } response = requests.request("POST", url, headers=headers, data=payload) res=response.json() if not res.get("data"): break result.extend([x for x in res.get("data") if x["STATE"]=="1"]) self.log(f"岗位完成--{len(result)}") return {"data":result} @staticmethod def model_list(param): """ 调用hcm.model.list接口获取符合条件的模型数据列表。 参数param是一个字典，用于指定查询条件，包括模型名称、过滤条件、分页信息、额外属性（如字段筛选、排序、关联关系等）。 返回接口调用的结果，即符合条件的模型数据列表。 """ return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.list', param) @staticmethod def model_create(model, info): """ 调用hcm.model.create接口给指定模型插入一条数据。 :param model: 要插入数据的模型名称 :param info: 要插入的数据信息，以字典形式表示 :return: 接口调用的结果 """ return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.create', {"model": model, "info": info}) @staticmethod def model_edit(model, id_, info): """ 调用hcm.model.edit接口根据ID修改指定模型的数据。 :param model: 要修改数据的模型名称 :param id_: 要修改数据的模型ID :param info: 要修改的数据信息，以字典形式表示 :return: 接口调用的结果 """ return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.edit', {"model": model, "id_": id_, "info": info}) @staticmethod def depart_revoke(id_, begin_date): """ 调用org.position.revoke接口根据ID和开始日期变更模型数据。 :param id_: 要变更数据的模型ID :param begin_date: 开始日期 :return: 接口调用的结果 """ return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('org.position.revoke', {'object_id': id_, 'effdt': begin_date}) def get_emp_data(self,num): """ 从指定的URL获取组织性能相关的数据（这里虽然定义了请求，但目前请求数据为空）。 返回获取到的响应文本内容。 """ result=[] for i in range(1,300): url = "http://192.168.1.22/hana/personal/getPerformancePersonal" # today = datetime.date.today().strftime('%Y%m%d') payload = json.dumps({ "startDate": '20250101', "endDate": '20250924', "pageNum":i, "pageSize":1000 }) #payload = "" headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } response = requests.request("POST", url, headers=headers, data=payload) res=response.json() if not res.get("data"): break result.extend(res.get("data")) # result=[x for x in result if x["ACTION_ID"] in ["01","04"]] self.log(f"人员完成--{len(result)}") return {"data":result} def log(self, log_content): """ 记录日志信息，创建一个包含日志类型、创建时间和日志内容的字典， 然后调用hcm.model.create接口将日志信息插入到名为'dynamic_log'的模型中。 """ log_info = {"log_type": str('position_test'), "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-0d %H:%M:%S'), "content": str(log_content)} CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", {"model": "dynamic_log", "info": log_info})

posts.excerpt: 需求：360考核评分过程中超出限制人数实时提醒
posts.text: 需求：360考核评分过程中超出限制人数实时提醒 解决方案1234561、360考核活动上开启参数 实时计算；2、EvalNaireAnswer.json模型插件，配置类型，type:post_batch_save_naire_answer3、查询 唯一：EvalGroupRelation的id；EvalObjGroup.id:EvalScorer.obj_idEvalGroupRelation.scorer_group_id:EvalScorer.scorer_group_id且EvalGroupRelation.object_group_id:EvalObjGroup.id4、调eval.group.relation.get.current.group.relation.distribute（group_relation_id) 1、复制一个360考核活动，开启【元数据配置】12注意：1、状态必须是未启动，才能进入【测试模式】 2、配置模型插件 - 【plugins】 1234567"plugins": [ { "key": "post_excellent_30_per_plugin", "type": "post_batch_save_naire_answer", "name": "Excellent30Percent" }] 3、云函数 - 【Excellent30Percent】  ModelPlugInXXX(BaseModelPlugIn): """ 模型插件 应用范围：create_data,edit_data,remove_data,remove_datas 如果类型为pre，调用pre方法，类型为post，调用post方法 """ def _call_api(self, api_name, args_dict): """封装API调用逻辑""" res_obj = CustomerUtil.call_open_api(api_name, args_dict) return res_obj.get("list", []), res_obj.get("count", 0) def get_scorerid_list(self, ids): """ 打分关系 """ args_dict = { "model": "EvalScorer", "filter_dict": { "id": ids }, "page_index": 1, "page_size": 99999, "extra_property": { "role":"all" } } return self._call_api("hcm.model.list", args_dict) def get_EvalGroupRelation_list(self, scorer_group_id, object_group_id): """ 考核设置 """ args_dict = { "model": "EvalGroupRelation", "filter_dict": { "scorer_group_id": scorer_group_id, "object_group_id": object_group_id }, "page_index": 1, "page_size": 99999, "extra_property": { "role":"all" } } return self._call_api("hcm.model.list", args_dict) def get_EvalObject_list(self, ids): """ 测评对象 """ args_dict = { "model": "EvalObject", "filter_dict": { "id": ids }, "page_index": 1, "page_size": 99999, "extra_property": { "role":"all" } } return self._call_api("hcm.model.list", args_dict) def pre(self, company_id, **kwargs): """ Pre插件 kwargs:经过转换的原函数调用参数，经过干预后，返回kwargs继续调用原函数 """ return kwargs def post(self, company_id, result,**kwargs): """ Post插件 result：原函数调用返回的结果，经过干预后，返回 kwargs：原函数调用参数 """ try: # self.log(f"company_id-{company_id}") # self.log(f"result-{result}") # self.log(f"kwargs-{kwargs}") # 获取打分关系ID result_answer_dict = result.get('answer_list', {}) scorerid_list = [*result_answer_dict] self.log(f"scorerid_list-{scorerid_list}") scorerobj_list, scorerobj_num = self.get_scorerid_list(scorerid_list) self.log(f"scorerobj_list-{scorerobj_list}-scorerobj_num-{scorerobj_num}") # 查打分关系 # 打分人分组 scorer_groupid_set = { sg['id'] for sobj in scorerobj_list if (sg := sobj.get('scorer_group')) and sg.get('id') } # 人员ID employeeid_set = { emp['id'] for sobj in scorerobj_list if (emp := sobj.get('employee')) and emp.get('id') } # 被测评人ID scorer_objid_set = { sobj['obj_id'] for sobj in scorerobj_list if sobj.get('obj_id') is not None } # 如果需要列表格式 scorer_groupid_list = list(scorer_groupid_set) employeeid_list = list(employeeid_set) scorer_objid_list = list(scorer_objid_set) self.log(f"scorer_groupid_list-{scorer_groupid_list}-employeeid_list-{employeeid_list}-scorer_objid_list-{scorer_objid_list}") # 1、EvalObjGroup.id:EvalScorer.obj_id # 测评对象 eobject_list, eobject_count = self.get_EvalObject_list(scorer_objid_list) self.log(f"eobject_list-{eobject_list}-eobject_count-{eobject_count}") eobjgroupid_list = list({ group.get('id') for eobj in eobject_list if (group := eobj.get('object_group')) and group.get('id') }) self.log(f"eobjgroupid_list-{eobjgroupid_list}") # 2、EvalGroupRelation.scorer_group_id:EvalScorer.scorer_group_id且EvalGroupRelation.object_group_id:EvalObjGroup.id # 考核设置-查出唯一ID egrouprelation_list, egrouprelation_count = self.get_EvalGroupRelation_list(scorer_groupid_list[0], eobjgroupid_list[0]) self.log(f"egrouprelation_list-{egrouprelation_list}-egrouprelation_count-{egrouprelation_count}") egrouprelationid_list = [egr_obj.get("id", "") for egr_obj in egrouprelation_list] self.log(f"egrouprelationid_list-{egrouprelationid_list}") # 3、eval.group.relation.get.current.group.relation.distribute（传group_relation_id、scorer_group_id、employee_id） ruleobj_list= CustomerUtil.call_open_api("eval.group.relation.get.current.group.relation.distribute", { "group_relation_id": egrouprelationid_list[0] }) self.log(f"ruleobj_list-{ruleobj_list}") alart_msg = "" # 处理ruleobj_list为True的情况 if isinstance(ruleobj_list, list): # 判断tip，逗号前是空，代表通过的 for rule_obj in ruleobj_list: tip = rule_obj.get('tip', '') rule_name = rule_obj.get('rule_name', '') tip_list = tip.split('，') self.log(f"tip_list-{tip_list}") if (tip_list[0].replace(' ', '')) and ('不超过' in tip_list[0]): suptip_list = tip_list[0].split("不超过") alart_msg = f"{rule_name}应该不超过{suptip_list[1]}，{tip_list[1]}" break except Exception: self.log(traceback.format_exc()) alart_msg = "" if alart_msg: raise errors.DATA_RULE_ERROR.new().description(alart_msg) return result def record(self, content, type=3): company_id = CustomerUtil.get_current_context().company.id category = self.__class__.__name__ ModelUtil.create('SyncOuterRecord', { "company_id": company_id, "name": category, "category": category, "type": type, "content": content, "update_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") }) def log(self, content): """日志记录函数""" content_str = str(content) length = len(content_str) base_info = { "log_type": "Excellent30Percent", "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') } limit_byte = 500000 uuid_str = uuid.uuid4().hex if length <= limit_byte: return CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": content_str} }) total = math.ceil(length / limit_byte) for n, i in enumerate(range(0, length, limit_byte), 1): CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": f"{uuid_str}页数:{n:05d}~{total},长度:{length}]:---------------- \n{content_str[i:i+limit_byte]}"} })

1、获取token 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061class PrivateAPIService(BasePrivateApiService): """ 动态私有OpenAPI 使用方法 """ # 环境配置信息 USERNAME = "1234" PASSWORD = "f87f89e2-f8b8-4ced-8634-1234" # TOKEN_URL = "https://oa.nmgjttz.com/seeyon/rest/token" TOKEN_URL = "https://172.24.0.3/seeyon/rest/token" def get_token(self): # 设置请求头 headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json" } data = {"userName": self.USERNAME, "password": self.PASSWORD} response = requests.post(self.TOKEN_URL, data=json.dumps(data), headers=headers, verify=False) return response def execute(self, **kwargs): try: response = self.get_token() status_code = response.status_code self.log(f"status_code:{status_code}") response_text =response.text # html的字符串在日志里不显示，特殊处理下 log_text_str = response_text.replace('<', '《').replace('>', '》') self.log(f"html特殊处理:log_text_str:{log_text_str}") # 检查HTTP状态码 if status_code != 200: self.log(f"请求失败，状态码-status_code:{status_code}-log_text_str:{log_text_str}") return None response_json = response.json() # 检查响应中是否包含id字段 if "id" in response_json: id_value = response_json["id"] self.log(f"成功获取ID: {id_value}") return id_value else: print("") self.log(f"响应中未找到id字段-status_code:{status_code}-response_text:{response_text}") return None # return None except Exception as e: self.log(f'获取OAtoken错误:{ traceback.format_exc()}') raise e def log(self, log_content): log_info = { "log_type": str('GetSeeyonToken'), "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), "content": str(log_content) } CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", {"model": "U_OADataLog", "info": log_info}) 2、待办 PrivateAPIService(BasePrivateApiService): """ 动态私有OpenAPI 使用方法 """ # OA host地址 # OA_HOST = "oa.nmgjttz.com" OA_HOST = "172.24.0.3" # 待办 RECEIVE_URL = f"https://{OA_HOST}/seeyon/rest/thirdpartyPending/receive" def get_emp_info(self, emp_number): """ 获取人员信息 """ emp_list = CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.list',{ "model": "Employee", "filter_dict": { "number": emp_number }, "page_index": 1, "page_size": 20, "extra_property": { "state": "all", "role": "all", "fields":[ {"field":["u_oaemp_id"]}, {"field":["name"]}, {"field":["u_oaloginname"]} ] } })['list'] emp_info = {} if emp_list: emp_info = emp_list[0] return emp_info def exec_send_message(self, api_url, payload_data): """ 发送消息到指定URL """ try: # 设置默认请求头 headers_data = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', } payload = json.dumps(payload_data) # 发送POST请求 response = requests.request("POST", api_url, headers=headers_data, data=payload, verify=False) try: result = response.json() except json.JSONDecodeError: result = response.text return { "status": response.status_code, "success": response.status_code == 200, "data": result, "msg": "" } except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: return { "status": 0, "success": False, "msg": str(e), "data": '' } def execute(self, **kwargs): try: self.log(f"kwargs-{kwargs}") # 数据格式 # kwargs-{ # 'requestname': '请参加【公信力测评-副本-副本】活动，进行打分', # 'creator': '000003', # 'createdatetime': '2025-12-1515: 46: 09', # 'receiver': '000002', # 'receivedatetime': '2025-12-1515: 46: 09', # 'receivets': '1765784769179', # 'assignment_info_number': None, # 'business_info_name': None, # 'assignment_info_wf_name': None, # 'assignment_info_approve_state': None, # 'go_param': '{ # "act_id": 8567, # "employee_id": 5189524, # "is_instruct": "false", # "message_id": 224 # }', # 'appurl': 'http: //58.18.169.198: 55088/login?sso=customer_sso&next=%2Fmessagerouter%3Fmessage_id%3D224', # 'pcurl': 'http: //58.18.169.198: 55088/login?sso=customer_sso&next=%2Fmessagerouter%3Fmessage_id%3D224' # } message_id = kwargs.get("msgid", {}) pcurl = kwargs.get("pcurl", "") requestname = kwargs.get("requestname", "") receiver_num = kwargs.get("receiver", "") creator_num = kwargs.get("creator", "") create_datetime = kwargs.get("createdatetime", "") # 接收人 receiver_info = self.get_emp_info(receiver_num) self.log(f"receiver_info-{receiver_info}") # 发送人 sender_info = self.get_emp_info(creator_num) self.log(f"sender_info-{sender_info}") if (not receiver_info) or (not sender_info): return { "status": 10000, "success": False, "data": '', "msg": "未获取到人员信息" } r_oaloginname = receiver_info.get('u_oaloginname', '') s_oaloginname = sender_info.get('u_oaloginname', '') self.log(f"receiver_oaloginname-{r_oaloginname}-s_oaloginname-{s_oaloginname}") if (not r_oaloginname) or (not s_oaloginname): return { "status": 10000, "success": False, "data": '', "msg": "未获取到OA系统人员的登录名" } payload_data = { "taskId": message_id, "registerCode": "3002", "title": requestname, "senderName": sender_info.get("name",""), "creationDate": create_datetime, "state":"0", "url": pcurl, "noneBindingSender": s_oaloginname, "noneBindingReceiver": r_oaloginname } self.log(f"payload_data-{payload_data}") # OA Token 信息 oa_token = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("private.GetSeeyonToken", {}) if not oa_token: self.log(f"获取token值失败-{oa_token}") return { "status": 90000, "success": False, "data": '', "msg": "获取token失败" } # 构建url api_sendmsg_url = f"{self.RECEIVE_URL}?token={oa_token}" self.log(f"api_sendmsg_url-{api_sendmsg_url}") resp_result = self.exec_send_message(api_sendmsg_url, payload_data) self.log(f"resp_result-{resp_result}") return resp_result except Exception as e: self.log(f'推送待办消息错误:{ traceback.format_exc()}') raise e def log(self, content): """日志记录函数""" content_str = str(content) length = len(content_str) base_info = { "log_type": "ToDoMsgToSeeyonOA", "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') } limit_byte = 500000 uuid_str = uuid.uuid4().hex if length <= limit_byte: return CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": content_str} }) total = math.ceil(length / limit_byte) for n, i in enumerate(range(0, length, limit_byte), 1): CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": f"{uuid_str}页数:{n:05d}~{total},长度:{length}]:---------------- 
{content_str[i:i+limit_byte]}"} }) 3、待办取消123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566676869707172737475767778798081828384858687888990919293949596979899100101102103104105106107108109110111112113114115116117118119120121122123124125126127128129class PrivateAPIService(BasePrivateApiService): """ 动态私有OpenAPI 使用方法 """ # "is_instruct": "false", # "message_id": 224 # }', # 'appurl': 'http: //58.18.169.198: 55088/login?sso=customer_sso&next=%2Fmessagerouter%3Fmessage_id%3D224', # 'pcurl': 'http: //58.18.169.198: 55088/login?sso=customer_sso&next=%2Fmessagerouter%3Fmessage_id%3D224' # } message_id = kwargs.get("msgid", {}) payload_data = { "registerCode":"3002", "taskId": message_id, "state":"1", "subState":"0" } self.log(f"payload_data-{payload_data}") # OA Token 信息 oa_token = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("private.GetSeeyonToken", {}) if not oa_token: self.log(f"获取token值失败-{oa_token}") return { "status": 90000, "success": False, "data": '', "msg": "获取token失败" } # 构建url api_sendmsg_url = f"{self.CANCL_URL}?token={oa_token}" self.log(f"api_sendmsg_url-{api_sendmsg_url}") resp_result = self.exec_send_message(api_sendmsg_url, payload_data) self.log(f"resp_result-{resp_result}") return resp_result except Exception as e: self.log(f'推送待办消息错误:{ traceback.format_exc()}') raise e def log(self, content): """日志记录函数""" content_str = str(content) length = len(content_str) base_info = { "log_type": "CancelToDoMsgToSeeyonOA", "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') } limit_byte = 500000 uuid_str = uuid.uuid4().hex if length <= limit_byte: return CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": content_str} }) total = math.ceil(length / limit_byte) for n, i in enumerate(range(0, length, limit_byte), 1): CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": f"{uuid_str}页数:{n:05d}~{total},长度:{length}]:---------------- 
{content_str[i:i+limit_byte]}"} }) 4、通知 PrivateAPIService(BasePrivateApiService): """ 动态私有OpenAPI 使用方法 """ # OA host地址 # OA_HOST = "oa.nmgjttz.com" OA_HOST = "172.24.0.3" # 发送协同消息 - 接收人为用户ID SENDMSG_URL = f"https://{OA_HOST}/seeyon/rest/message/userId" def get_emp_info(self, emp_number): """ 获取人员信息 """ emp_list = CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.list',{ "model": "Employee", "filter_dict": { "number": emp_number }, "page_index": 1, "page_size": 20, "extra_property": { "state": "all", "role": "all", "fields":[ {"field":["u_oaemp_id"]} ] } })['list'] emp_info = {} if emp_list: emp_info = emp_list[0] return emp_info def exec_send_message(self, api_url, payload_data): """ 发送消息到指定URL """ try: # 设置默认请求头 headers_data = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', } payload = json.dumps(payload_data) # 发送POST请求 response = requests.request("POST", api_url, headers=headers_data, data=payload, verify=False) try: result = response.json() except json.JSONDecodeError: result = response.text return { "status": response.status_code, "success": response.status_code == 200, "data": result, "msg": "" } except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: return { "status": 0, "success": False, "msg": str(e), "data": '' } def execute(self, **kwargs): try: self.log(f"kwargs-{kwargs}") # 数据格式 # kwargs-{ # 'requestname': '请参加【公信力测评-副本-副本】活动，进行打分', # 'creator': '000003', # 'createdatetime': '2025-12-1515: 46: 09', # 'receiver': '000002', # 'receivedatetime': '2025-12-1515: 46: 09', # 'receivets': '1765784769179', # 'assignment_info_number': None, # 'business_info_name': None, # 'assignment_info_wf_name': None, # 'assignment_info_approve_state': None, # 'go_param': '{ # "act_id": 8567, # "employee_id": 5189524, # "is_instruct": "false", # "message_id": 224 # }', # 'appurl': 'http: //58.18.169.198: 55088/login?sso=customer_sso&next=%2Fmessagerouter%3Fmessage_id%3D224', # 'pcurl': 'http: //58.18.169.198: 55088/login?sso=customer_sso&next=%2Fmessagerouter%3Fmessage_id%3D224' # } # pcurl = kwargs.get("pcurl", "") requestname = kwargs.get("requestname", "") receiver_num = kwargs.get("receiver", "") creator_num = kwargs.get("creator", "") # 接收人 send_emp_info = self.get_emp_info(receiver_num) self.log(f"send_emp_info-{send_emp_info}") # 发送人 from_emp_info = self.get_emp_info(creator_num) self.log(f"from_emp_info-{from_emp_info}") if (not send_emp_info) or (not from_emp_info): # self.log(f"send_emp_info-{send_emp_info}-from_emp_info-{from_emp_info}") return { "status": 10000, "success": False, "data": '', "msg": "未获取到人员信息" } s_oaemp_id = send_emp_info.get('u_oaemp_id', '') f_oaemp_id = from_emp_info.get('u_oaemp_id', '') self.log(f"s_oaemp_id-{s_oaemp_id}-f_oaemp_id-{f_oaemp_id}") if (not s_oaemp_id) or (not f_oaemp_id): return { "status": 10000, "success": False, "data": '', "msg": "未获取到人员对应的oa id" } payload_data = { "userIds": [int(send_emp_info.get('u_oaemp_id', ''))], "sendUserId": from_emp_info.get('u_oaemp_id', ''), "content": requestname # "url" : [pcurl], } self.log(f"payload_data-{payload_data}") # OA Token 信息 oa_token = CustomerUtil.call_open_api("private.GetSeeyonToken", {}) if not oa_token: self.log(f"获取token值失败-{oa_token}") return { "status": 90000, "success": False, "data": '', "msg": "获取token失败" } # 构建url api_sendmsg_url = f"{self.SENDMSG_URL}?token={oa_token}" self.log(f"api_sendmsg_url-{api_sendmsg_url}") resp_result = self.exec_send_message(api_sendmsg_url, payload_data) self.log(f"resp_result-{resp_result}") return resp_result except Exception as e: self.log(f'推送待办消息错误:{ traceback.format_exc()}') raise e def log(self, content): """日志记录函数""" content_str = str(content) length = len(content_str) base_info = { "log_type": "PushMsgToSeeyonOA", "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') } limit_byte = 500000 uuid_str = uuid.uuid4().hex if length <= limit_byte: return CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": content_str} }) total = math.ceil(length / limit_byte) for n, i in enumerate(range(0, length, limit_byte), 1): CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", { "model": "U_OADataLog", "info": {**base_info, "content": f"{uuid_str}页数:{n:05d}~{total},长度:{length}]:---------------- 
{content_str[i:i+limit_byte]}"} }) 5、单点 (必须2个函数) customer_sso customer_sso_18815757（组织根ID） customer_sso(SSOService): __third_type__ = "customer_sso" __authorize_type__ = "customer_sso" __description__ = "个性化单点登录" HCM_LOGIN_URL = "http://1.12.13.14:508/login" MAP_KEY = "number" # 字段映射 # MAP_KEY = "mobile" # 字段映射 # OA_LOGINNAME_URL = "https://oa.nmgjttz.com/seeyon/thirdpartyController.do" OA_LOGINNAME_URL = "https://1.2.3.4/seeyon/thirdpartyController.do" def get_oahcm_emp_info(self, mid): """获取user表的数据""" param = { "model": "Employee", "filter_dict": { "u_oaemp_id": mid }, "page_index": 1, "page_size": 20, "extra_property": { "state": "all", "role": "all" } } return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.list', param)["list"] def get_ticket_from_url(self, url): """ 从URL中提取ticket参数值 """ try: parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(url) query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query) ticket = query_params.get('ticket') if ticket: return ticket[0] else: return None except Exception as e: self.log(f"解析URL出错: {e}") return None def get_memberid(self, ticket): """ 获取loginName """ try: url = f"{self.OA_LOGINNAME_URL}?ticket={ticket}" self.log(f"MemberId-url-{url}") # 发送请求 resp = requests.get(url, verify=False, timeout=10) self.log(f"MemberId-code-{resp.status_code}") self.log(f"MemberId-text-{resp.text}") # 查找LoginName self.log(f"headers-{resp.headers}") for key in resp.headers: if key.lower() == 'memberid': return str(resp.headers[key]) return None except Exception as e: self.log(f"获取MemberId异常: {e}") return None def get_authorize_redirect(self, redirect_uri, handler): """ 地址重定向 :param redirect_uri: :param handler: :return: """ # self.__redirect_uri__ = redirect_uri # url = "{}/idp/oauth2/authorize?redirect_uri={}&state={}&client_id={}&response_type={}".format( # self.__server_url__, urllib.parse.quote(self.__redirect_uri__), self.__state__, self.__client_id__, # self.__response_type__) self.log("get_code_url:{}".format(redirect_uri)) return redirect_uri def get_sso_user(self, handler): try: self.log(f"handler-{handler}") self.log(f"handler.request-{handler.request}") self.log(f"handler.request.arguments-{handler.request.arguments}") # 获取ticket ticket_dict = handler.request.arguments ticket_list = ticket_dict.get('ticket', '') if not ticket_list: ticket_list = ticket_dict.get('v5ticket', '') if not ticket_list: return None ticket = ticket_list[0] ticket_str = ticket.decode('utf-8') # 获取login_name member_id = self.get_memberid(ticket_str) self.log(f"member_id-{member_id}") if not member_id: return None emp_list = self.get_oahcm_emp_info(member_id) self.log(f"emp_list-{emp_list}") account_id = None if emp_list: # account_id = emp_list[0].get('mobile', '') account_id = emp_list[0].get('number', '') self.log(f"account_id-{account_id}") return {self.MAP_KEY: account_id, "id": account_id, "openid": account_id} if account_id else None except Exception as e: self.log(traceback.format_exc()) raise e def get_cloud_user(self, sso_user): """获取人员信息""" employee_info = self.get_employee_info(self.MAP_KEY, sso_user.get(self.MAP_KEY)) if employee_info: mobile = employee_info.get("mobile") user = self.get_user(mobile) return user[0] if user else self.create_info(mobile) else: return None @staticmethod def create_info(mobile): """新增至user表""" return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.create', {"model": "User", "info": {"cell_phone": mobile}}) @staticmethod def get_user(mobile): """获取user表的数据""" param = { "model": "User", "filter_dict": { "cell_phone": mobile }, "extra_property": { "only_list": True } } return CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.list', param)["list"] @staticmethod def get_employee_info(key, value): """获取人员信息""" param = { "model": "Employee", "filter_dict": {key: value}, "extra_property": { "only_list": True, "fields": [ {"field": ["mobile"], "key": "mobile"} ], "relations": [ { "filter": { "job_info.employee_id": ":id", "job_info.position_type": "1", "job_info.on_job": "1", "job_info.begin_date": { "lte": "=date_" }, "job_info.end_date": { "gt": "=date_" } }, "model": "JobInformation", "name": "任职信息", "key": "job_info" } ] } } res = CustomerUtil.call_open_api('hcm.model.list', param)["list"] return res[0] if res else None def customer_logout(self,handler): _cache_key=handler.get_secure_cookie("customer_sso") self.clear_cached("customer_sso_{}".format(_cache_key)) return self.HCM_LOGIN_URL def log(self, content, type_=1): log_info = {"log_type": str('customer_sso'), "create_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), "content": str(content)} CustomerUtil.call_open_api("hcm.model.create", {"model": "U_OADataLog", "info": log_info})
